test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: “Magnus Carlsen” is associated with which of the following games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Magnus Carlsen was born on November 30, **1990, in Norway**.
 
• He showed an early interest in** chess** and started playing the game at a very young age.
 
• Carlsen is known for his** universal style of play**.
 
• Carlsen excels in both positional **play and dynamic, tactical positions.**
 
• His ability to outmaneuver opponents in **long, strategic battles is often considered his greatest strength**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Sport
 Description
 Associated Term
 
 
 
 

 Boxing
 A combat sport where two people throw punches at each other for a predetermined amount of time in a boxing ring.
 Knockout: A fight-ending, winning criterion in several full-contact combat sports, where one participant is unable to rise from the canvas within a specified amount of time after a knockdown.
 
 

 Golf
 An outdoor game where players use clubs to hit a small ball into a series of holes on a course, trying to get each ball in with as few hits as possible.
 Par: The standard number of strokes that a proficient golfer is expected to take to complete a hole, or round, making allowance for the tee shot and two putts.
 
 

 Chess
 A two-player strategy board game played on a checkered board with 64 squares arranged in an 8×8 grid. Each player begins with 16 pieces.
 Checkmate: The position in chess where a player's king is in a position to be captured (in "check") and there is no way to move the king out of capture (mate).
 
 

 Table Tennis
 Also known as ping pong, it's a sport where two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small rackets. The game takes place on a hard table divided by a net.
 Rally: The period during which the ball is in play. It begins when the server strikes the ball and ends when the ball is out of play.
